title: Stand up external durable snapshot storage before any more capturing
what_it_improves: Every capture in the repo currently lives inside the static site's own repository, so a schema change, a force-push or a branch deletion rewrites history. Snapshots cannot be immutable in the same store that serves the site.
evidence_needed: an external store, a retention rule, and a hash chain verification job
note: This is the single highest-leverage item: seven requirements are blocked on it.

title: Decide the price-data policy in writing, now
what_it_improves: The owner's own rule says decide the policy before any backtest is published. No policy exists, so no backtest with prices may be published.
evidence_needed: a written decision: which hosts may be captured, at what rate, and what may be republished
note: The decision must be dated and committed; the commit is the evidence that it preceded the first backtest.

title: Resolve the depth-order source, club by club, before building any deficiency feature
what_it_improves: The owner ordered this explicitly: evaluate per-club depth pages first, snap counts second, and do not build the backup-deficiency feature until one route is verified for all 32 clubs.
evidence_needed: 32/32 clubs with a parsed, dated depth capture and the raw string retained
note: Fourteen requirements sit behind this one. It is the largest cluster on the board.

title: Decide what to do about the Texans depth image
what_it_improves: One club publishes depth as an image. Transcribing it by eye is exactly the kind of unverifiable step the rest of the board exists to prevent.
evidence_needed: whether an authorized structured source for the Texans depth exists
note: The honest options are 'find a structured source' or 'exclude the club and say so'.

title: Join designations to the official inactive list and calibrate 'Questionable'
what_it_improves: This session can count designations but cannot say what they predict, because the outcome leg (did the player play?) has never been captured.
evidence_needed: the official inactive list for every game in the window, joined to the designation rows
note: The numerator is ready: 90 Questionable rows and 11 Doubtful rows are counted and published with n.

title: Automate the Wednesday / Thursday / Friday injury capture
what_it_improves: One read is not a series. Practice-designation trends (DNP to LP to FP) are invisible without at least three dated reads inside a week.
evidence_needed: a scheduled job writing an immutable, hashed capture with a fetch timestamp
note: This session's 2026-11-18 read is a Wednesday read and is consistent with the start of the cadence, but starting is not the same as running.

title: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff as the default view
what_it_improves: A static snapshot hides the thing that matters, which is movement. A diff needs two snapshots, so it is downstream of S-06.
evidence_needed: two or more dated snapshots of the same object
note: Cheap once snapshots exist; impossible before they do.

title: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
what_it_improves: Row-level official data is currently published in the public site while the terms question is unanswered.
evidence_needed: the terms decision from S-02, plus somewhere private to put the raw rows
note: Sequencing: do S-02 first, because the answer determines whether this is necessary.

title: Nominate one canonical dataset out of the 20+ existing packs
what_it_improves: Twenty-plus packs each carry their own copy of overlapping registers with different column vocabularies, so no reviewer can compare two of them.
evidence_needed: an inventory of every register and a written nomination of one canonical set
note: Consolidation is a decision, not a technical problem: somebody has to say which copy wins.

title: Pre-register the singles-only shadow baseline with a real commit hash
what_it_improves: Pre-registration is only real if the commit predates the evaluation window. Registering retroactively is not registration.
evidence_needed: the rule text, the sample window, the gates, and a commit made before the window opens
note: The cheapest high-value item on the board: it costs one commit and unlocks the leaderboard.

title: Add control baselines to every leaderboard run and show them by default
what_it_improves: Without a random-pick control and a favourites-only control, a leaderboard cannot separate skill from a favourable sample.
evidence_needed: both controls scored on the same settled sample as the strategies
note: Controls are cheap; the settled sample is the scarce part.

title: Choose the proper score and the benchmark it is measured against
what_it_improves: 'Benchmark-relative Brier skill' is unspecified until someone names the benchmark.
evidence_needed: a written choice of score and benchmark, committed before the first scoring run
note: Choose before scoring, or the choice is contaminated by results.

title: Set the multiplicity adjustment and the minimum number of trials
what_it_improves: Ranking many strategies on a short sample manufactures a winner. The adjustment must be fixed before the first ranking.
evidence_needed: a written rule: minimum n, and the adjustment applied across the number of strategies tried
note: Write it down first; do not tune it after seeing the ranking.

title: Define what counts as validated joint evidence for parlays and prop combos
what_it_improves: Multiplying marginals is invalid under dependence. The gate is shut today; the question is what reopens it.
evidence_needed: a validated joint probability for the specific leg set, plus the operator's void/push rules
note: Recommendation recorded here: keep the gate shut until both halves exist.

title: Set the numeric thresholds of the demotion gate
what_it_improves: A demotion rule with no threshold never fires, and a rule that never fires is not a rule.
evidence_needed: a numeric threshold, a monitoring cadence, and the paper-return procedure
note: Set the threshold before the strategy goes live, not after a drawdown.

title: Decide where the removal-of-luck panel lives and what it must show
what_it_improves: Several packs publish a luck panel that is empty by design. A panel that is always empty teaches the reader nothing.
evidence_needed: a settled sample; until then, decide whether to show the control-only version or hide the panel
note: Showing a control-only panel with the sample size that would populate it is honest; showing a fabricated one is not.

title: Find the official stadium roof/surface designation and pair it with NWS
what_it_improves: Totals and passing props are mispriced when a dome game is treated as outdoor, but the roof designation is published by the league, not inferable.
evidence_needed: one dated official roof designation per fixture, plus the matching NWS grid forecast
note: Note for the reviewer: NWS is an official US government source (api.weather.gov), so the weather half is easier than the roof half.

title: Quote the official 2026 kickoff and onside-kick rule text before setting priors
what_it_improves: A regime prior built on remembered rules is a hallucination with a number attached.
evidence_needed: the official rule text quoted with its source URL
note: Until the text is read, the honest prior is blank.

title: Transcribe venue only from the official game centre text
what_it_improves: Twelve of the thirteen Week 11 venue strings came from a hotel affiliate link on the schedule page, which is on the official page but is not a venue field.
evidence_needed: the venue as named in the official game centre or box score text
note: Flagged this session. The reviewer should decide whether the affiliate-link provenance is acceptable or whether every row must be re-read from the game centre.

title: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons
what_it_improves: The designation-reliability measurement needs several seasons, and the repo currently holds a handful of reads from one season.
evidence_needed: a retention job writing dated weekly archives, plus a backfill source for prior seasons
note: Backfill is the hard half: past weeks are only recoverable if somebody saved them.

title: Design the injury/depth ablation before the depth source clears
what_it_improves: The owner forbade fixed penalties and asked for a paired ablation with uncertainty. The design can be frozen now, even though it cannot run yet.
evidence_needed: the two model specifications, the chronological holdout windows, and the uncertainty method
note: Freezing the design now is exactly the pre-registration discipline the owner asked for elsewhere.

title: Commit the train / validation / final-holdout season split
what_it_improves: Out-of-sample means nothing until the split is fixed in writing before fitting.
evidence_needed: three disjoint season windows committed to the repo
note: Cheap and reversible only if done before the first fit.

title: Pin every parser to an expected row count and a required field set
what_it_improves: A parser that silently publishes an empty column is worse than a parser that fails loudly.
evidence_needed: a per-source expected row count and required-field list, checked in CI
note: This pack does it; the reviewer should decide whether to enforce it repo-wide.

title: Show 'starters out' per club without inventing the replacement
what_it_improves: The per-team view the owner asked for is half computable today and half not. Publishing the computable half with the other half blank is more useful than publishing neither.
evidence_needed: a verified depth order (for the replacement half only)
note: This session can count Out per club from official rows; it cannot name a replacement for any of them.

title: Fix the fixture-context feature list to published schedule facts only
what_it_improves: Rest days, travel and timezone are tempting and are not printed on the official schedule page, so using them means inferring.
evidence_needed: a written feature list, each item traceable to a field the official schedule page prints
note: This session's 13 fixtures carry date, kickoff, network, venue and records - and nothing else.

title: Name the two estimators for totals and the walk-forward rule that collapses them
what_it_improves: 'Publish every model total twice until one wins' is unactionable until both estimators and the winning condition are named.
evidence_needed: two named estimators, a gap column, and a written walk-forward comparison rule
note: The collapse rule must be a number, not a judgement.

title: Define what the leaderboard 'reward' is and who funds it
what_it_improves: The competition needs a payoff rule fixed before anyone competes, or the incentive is to game whatever the payoff turns out to be.
evidence_needed: a written reward rule, its funding, and the eligibility criterion
note: Recommendation recorded here: make the reward contingent on the proper-score qualification, never on realised ROI (the owner already rejected ROI ranking in R-65).

title: Decide whether the 20+ pack sub-sites stay on the hub
what_it_improves: The shared hub now links more than twenty overlapping NFL packs, which makes the site hard to use for the decision the owner actually wants to make.
evidence_needed: a written navigation policy: which packs are canonical, which are archive, which are hidden
note: Related to S-09: the data decision and the navigation decision should be made together.

title: Decide how bye-week absences are presented
what_it_improves: Four clubs have no Week 10 injury section. Rendering that as zero injuries would be false; rendering it as a blank row is true but looks like a bug.
evidence_needed: a presentation rule: 'not listed (bye)' with the source link, never '0 injuries'
note: This session renders it as absence with the reason recorded, and flags it.

title: Merge or drop the duplicated requirements in the register
what_it_improves: The owner's list contains at least two deliberate duplicates (R-27/R-28 and R-67/R-69) and several partial overlaps (R-29/R-30).
evidence_needed: the owner's decision on each duplicate
note: Kept as separate rows on purpose so the merge is a decision rather than a silent edit.
